Name: (Nerdsnipe Series) Make Buffs Invisible
Author: DecidedlyHuman
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod does nothing on its own.[/color][/size]

[b][size=5]Main features[/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This assumes you're already familiar with basic Content Patcher, and have a custom buff (or are editing an existing buff) you want to make invisible in the HUD. [/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]You just need to add a [font=Courier New]CustomField[/font] named [font=Courier New]DH.Buffs.Invisible[/font][/color]. The value can be empty, or anything you like. Maybe leave a joke easter egg for people looking through your mod's files!

If you need help, or find a problem, ping me ([font=Courier New]@decidedlyhuman[/font]) in [font=Courier New]#making-mods-general[/font] in the Stardew Valley Discord server.
